sections.description: The core bridge between Exacoat Manager ERP, WooCommerce orders, custom status, and fulfillment tracking.
sections.changelog:
### Version 0.1.34
- Clean media URL support stripping /wp-content/uploads/ for direct CDN delivery
- Active CDN symlink bridge for media.exacoat.com serving staging and production uploads
- Unified maskMediaUrl routing all WordPress asset derivatives through edge CDN
